description: Bus Timetable Data and Geographic Information - Alice Springs is a dataset listed in Northern Territory Government open data portal (data.nt.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Logistics and Infrastructure. Static timetable data and geographic information about the Darwin and Alice Springs public bus network is provided in the General Transit Feed Specification (GTFS) format. Coverage: Northern Territory. The portal files it under the publisher Logistics and Infrastructure. It offers 1 resource(s) in gtfs. The portal shows 2021-06-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-nt-government-open-data-portal.
